maintenance_led.reason: Sells reagents, instruments, assays, diagnostics and software for research and screening; mostly consumables and new product sales, not repair or maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are pharma, biotech, CROs, labs and diagnostic users, paid by private firms, commercial payers and some academic grants.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own life science and diagnostics products; acquisitions such as BioLegend are occasional, not a continuous roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Qualified assays, newborn screening, T-SPOT.TB diagnostics and instrument-linked workflows mean validation and retraining make switching costly.
